words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 请扫码点餐和付款。(Qǐng sǎomǎ diǎncān hé fùkuǎn.) — Please scan the QR code to order and pay.
请出示您的健康码或付款二维码。(Qǐng chūshì nín de jiànkāngmǎ huò fùkuǎn èrwéimǎ.) — Please show your health code or payment QR code.
在中国移动支付非常普及。(Zài Zhōngguó yídòng zhīfù fēicháng pǔjí.) — In China mobile payment is extremely widespread.
我们加一下微信，方便以后联系。(Wǒmen jiā yíxià Wēixìn, fāngbiàn yǐhòu liánxì.) — Let's add each other on WeChat for easy contact.

words.English Meaning: to swipe a card / pay by card
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 请问这里可以刷信用卡吗？(Qǐngwèn zhèlǐ kěyǐ shuā xìnyòngkǎ ma?) — Excuse me, can I pay by credit card here?
我的交通卡没钱了，需要去充值。(Wǒ de jiāotōng kǎ méi qián le, xūyào qù chōngzhí.) — My transit card is out of money, I need to top it up.
请输入您的登录账号和密码。(Qǐng shūrù nín de dēnglù zhànghào hé mìmǎ.) — Please enter your login account and password.
请不要把银行卡密码告诉别人。(Qǐng bú yào bǎ yínhángkǎ mìmǎ gàosu biérén.) — Please do not disclose your bank card password to others.
你可以在应用商店免费下载这个软件。(Nǐ kěyǐ zài yìngyòng shāngdiàn miǎnfèi xiàzài zhè ge ruǎnjiàn.) — You can download this app for free in the app store.
消息已经成功发送出去了。(Xiāoxi yǐjīng chénggōng fāsòng chūqu le.) — The message has been sent successfully.
手机正在接收最新的系统更新。(Shǒujī zhèngzài jiēshōu zuìxīn de xìtǒng gēngxīn.) — The phone is receiving the latest system update.
这个学中文的软件很好用。(Zhè ge xué Zhōngwén de ruǎnjiàn hěn hǎoyòng.) — This Chinese learning app is very useful.
电梯里面手机一点信号都没有。(Diàntī lǐmiàn shǒujī yìdiǎn xìnhào dōu méiyǒu.) — There is no phone signal at all inside the elevator.
这里的网络连接速度非常快。(Zhèlǐ de wǎngluò liánjiē sùdù fēicháng kuài.) — The internet connection speed here is very fast.
手机电池只剩百分之十了。(Shǒujī diànchí zhǐ shèng bǎifēnzhī shí le.) — The phone battery only has 10% left.
我得给手机充电了。(Wǒ děi gěi shǒujī chōngdiàn le.) — I need to charge my phone.
饭馆门口可以租借共享充电宝。(Fànguǎn ménkǒu kěyǐ zūjiè gòngxiǎng chōngdiànbǎo.) — You can rent a shared power bank at the restaurant entrance.
这台平板电脑的屏幕很清晰。(Zhè tái píngbǎn diànnǎo de píngmù hěn qīngxī.) — The screen of this tablet is very clear.
今晚我们和父母视频通话吧。(Jīnwǎn wǒmen hé fùmǔ shìpín tōnghuà ba.) — Let's do a video call with our parents tonight.
打字不方便的时候可以发语音。(Dǎzì bù fāngbiàn de shíhou kěyǐ fā yǔyīn.) — You can send voice messages when typing is inconvenient.
系统刚给你的手机发了验证码。(Xìtǒng gāng gěi nǐ de shǒujī fā le yànzhèngmǎ.) — The system just sent a verification code to your phone.
看到消息后请尽快给我回复。(Kàndào xiāoxi hòu qǐng jǐnkuài gěi wǒ huífù.) — Please reply to me as soon as you see the message.

words.English Meaning: to follow (social media) / pay attention to
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 欢迎关注我们的官方公众号！(Huānyíng guānzhù wǒmen de guānfāng gōngzhònghào!) — Welcome to follow our official public account!
你在搜索引擎上查查这篇论文。(Nǐ zài sōusuǒ yǐnqíng shang chácha zhè piān lùnwén.) — Search for this paper on the search engine.
现代人越来越喜欢在家里网购。(Xiàndàirén yuèláiyuè xǐhuan zài jiālǐ wǎnggòu.) — Modern people increasingly like shopping online from home.
